General_Description.Text: Three-dimensional quantification of oxytocin neurons in the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus reveals sex- and subregion-specific differences in two genetic mouse models of autism (2025). Evidence category: application. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.

Tissue_Types.Text1:
samples:
id: sa1
statement: C57BL/6J 背景成年 8–15 周小鼠；Cntnap2 / Fmr1 各分 WT/KO 与雌/雄。研究不提供纵向年龄对比。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[1]/p[1]

biological_unit: mouse
age_weeks: 
  [1] 8
  [2] 15

samples:
id: sa2
statement: 2D 支路每脑约 8–10 张 50 μm PVN 冠状切片；切片不是独立动物。

branch: section
sections_per_brain: 8–10
animal_n: not explicitly resolved for each 2D subregion

fmr1_n_per_group: 4–6

Application.Text1:
processing_stages:
id: pr1
statement: 离体脑固定后隔夜后固定，PBS 保存；活体操作不在本次提取范围。

duration: overnight

Application.Text2:
processing_stages:
id: pr2
statement: 2D 切片经通透、封闭、NP1 PS38 一抗、AF488 抗鼠二抗与 DAPI 封片，再做人工分区细胞计数。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[3]/p
  sha256: a7131d89619884a1ae771348435ea8cea3bddf1ea84d368a4e81bed08809ffa9
branch: section
stage: labeling
primary: MABN844 1:5000 overnight 4C
secondary: donkey anti-mouse AF488 1:500 1h RT
blocking: 1h 4C
readout: OXT immunoreactivity; not direct total neuron number

Application.Text3:
processing_stages:
id: pr3
statement: 完整脑 SHIELD 保存分 OFF 和 ON 两阶段。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[4]/sec[1]/p
  sha256: 43644ed14eb7ea667e6bec3ab294b8ea468dfac2fc4e7971947a3462b7bb8d91
branch: whole_brain
stage: preservation
OFF: 3d 4C
ON: 24h 37C

Application.Text4:
processing_stages:
id: pr4
statement: Fmr1 支路主动脱脂；Cntnap2 支路被动脱脂；不同鼠系采用不同方法，不能作为随机配对方法比较。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[4]/sec[2]/p
  sha256: 526b35d8633f675b421300281b184a26ee41741c08ea138f34e3432116fe26ef
branch: whole_brain
stage: delipidation
Fmr1: 24h buffer pretreatment then 30h active 45C
Cntnap2: 6d passive 45C
unit_conflict: source reports 200 nM SDS and 10 nM conduction SDS; retained uncorrected, not ready-to-run recipe

Application.Text5:
processing_stages:
id: pr5
statement: 完整脑 NP1 PS38 抗鼠和 NeuN 抗兔双标；AF555 抗鼠对应 OXT 代理信号，AF488 抗兔对应 NeuN。不能把切片 AF488 对应关系带到整脑。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[4]/sec[3]/p
  sha256: e126a838773a0c4c52eaefad1f763f6f393f58b7c773d35b9bd401663007b8cb
stage: whole_brain_labeling
primary: NP1 PS38 1:1000; NeuN RPCA-FOX3 1:666
secondary: AF555 A32773 1:500; AF488 A32790 1:333
primary_preincubation: 24h RT
primary_label: approximately18h until pH<8 at30C
primary_wash: 2x4h then overnight postfix
secondary_preincubation: 8h 37C
secondary_label_duration: unknown
secondary_wash: 2x3h active then2x1h PBS; overnight postfix

Application.Text6:
processing_stages:
id: pr6
statement: EasyIndex 先 50% 再100%进行折射率匹配；此时间不等于总流程时间。

durations: 
  [1] 24h 50%
  [2] 4–7d 100%
temperature: 37C
RI: 1.52

Application.Text7:
processing_stages:
id: pr7
statement: 整脑匹配后琼脂糖包埋并再次匹配；90C 为制胶阶段，不能标为组织孵育温度。
source: 
  xpath: /article/body/sec[2]/sec[4]/sec[5]/p

gel_preparation: 90C 60min before tissue placement
gel_setting: 4C10min then30min
rematching: 48h RT

processing_stages:

statement: 位置参考 Bregma，0.03mm 分箱并汇总四亚区；原文使用平移公式却同时称体积矫正/缩放，不能当体积尺度校准。

Application.Text23:
records:
id: 2D_results
source_xpath: /article/body/sec[3]/sec[1]
branch: 50um_sections
findings: 
  [1] Cntnap2 male KO: RM higher, q=.009; female KO:M lower q=.008
  [2] Fmr1 female KO:RM higher q<.0001; source text incorrectly uses male-style -/Y for females in one sentence, not silently propagated
  [3] WT sex effects largely absent except Fmr1 WT RM q=.048
  [4] KO sex effects:Cntnap2 RM q<.0001,M q=.02;Fmr1 RM q=.002
  [5] Sex-matched WT normalization: Fmr1 female relative counts exceed Cntnap2 female in RM q<.0001 and M q=.0001;male Fmr1 below male Cntnap2 RM q=.0004;M q=.07 not significant

statistic: two-way ANOVA plus FDR;3D subregional Monte Carlo two-tailed 10000 permutations
restriction: Do not label normalized counts as raw cells or proportions of all neurons
